question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Final query - ensure integer types and correct output
WITH all_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT league_id, home_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT league_id, away_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
),
match_results AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        CAST(SUM(is_win) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM match_results
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
),
team_wins_full AS (
    SELECT 
        x.league_id,
        x.team_api_id,
        COALESCE(y.total_wins, 0) as total_wins
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT league_id, team_api_id FROM all_teams) x
    LEFT JOIN team_wins y ON x.league_id = y.league_id AND x.team_api_id = y.team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    z.league_id,
    l.name as league_name,
    z.team_api_id,
    tm.team_long_name,
    z.total_wins
FROM team_wins_full z
JOIN League l ON z.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team tm ON z.team_api_id = tm.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY z.league_id ORDER BY z.total_wins ASC, tm.team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY z.league_id

{"sql": "-- Build the full query with wins per team per league - fix alias issue
WITH all_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT league_id, home_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT league_id, away_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
),
match_results AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(is_win)::INTEGER as total_wins
    FROM match_results
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
),
team_wins_full AS (
    SELECT 
        at.league_id,
        at.team_api_id,
        COALESCE(tw.total_wins, 0) as total_wins
    FROM all_teams at
    LEFT JOIN team_wins tw ON at.league_id = tw.league_id AND at.team_api_id = tw.team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    t.league_id,
    l.name as league_name,
    t.team_api_id,
    tm.team_long_name,
    t.total_wins
FROM team_wins_full t
JOIN League l ON t.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team tm ON t.team_api_id = tm.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.league_id ORDER BY t.total_wins ASC, tm.team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY t.league_id", "preview_rows": 20}
